title: Printed Thickness and Trace-to-Trace Electrical Variability in Liquid Metal Particle Stretchable Interconnects
authors: Min Jong Lee, Sang Heon Lee, and Jae Won Shim*
journalName: Journal of Flexible and Printed Electronics
summary: Examines how doctor-blade-printed film thickness contributes to electrical differences between nominally identical liquid-metal-particle traces, distinguishing initial nonuniformity from resistance changes under repeated deformation.
source: AEEL official publications list, accessed November 2026
